A fitness-independent family of simultaneous amplifiers beyond relative fitness 3/2
A carefully weighted population structure can help a beneficial mutation spread under either of two opposing update orders, for a slightly wider range of fitness than previously achieved.

One graph sequence chosen independently of fitness amplifies both pure Bd and dB fixation for each fixed fitness below 1.5028569…, disproving 3/2 as an unrestricted threshold while optimizing the stated dilute response model.
The qualitative threshold crossing and correct fitness-independent quantifier are useful advances, although the numerical gain is small and finite-size practicality is limited.
Rare paired niches and hub leaves have opposite effects under the two rules, but their densities can be balanced so one fitness-independent family benefits both.
